description: Uses Kolmogorov complexity to sieve for high-delay Collatz numbers by targeting intermediate effective complexity.
mathematical_formalization: Effective complexity C_eff(n) = K(n) - K(regularity(n)). Target H(bits(n)) ≈ 0.6-0.8.
analogical_connections: Edge of chaos in cellular automata
implementation_hypothesis: Sieve by zlib compression ratio of binary representation; Goldilocks zone candidates tested.
experiment_seed: 100K numbers stratified by compression ratio in 2^50 to 2^60 range.
